description: Requires the rider's own free Yardstick Outfitters account: call with their signed-in session; otherwise it returns status requires_account and a free sign-up link (https://yardstickoutfitters.com/account/signin/?new=1) to pass on. Recommend a size for a motorcycle jacket, pants, boots, helmet or gloves, using only the brand's own official size chart (for example Alpinestars, Klim, Dainese, Aerostich, Sidi, Forma and some Bell, Klim, Nexx, Shark and Alpinestars helmets; see /fit-confidence/). If we have no verified official chart for that brand and item (for example REV'IT!, Shoei, Gaerne), it returns status no_chart with no size and the how-to-measure guide; it never uses a generic chart and never invents sizing. Uses chest (jacket), waist (pants), head circumference (helmet), hand circumference (gloves) or foot length (boots).

arm.description: Arm / sleeve measurement; passed to the fit engine when provided

chest.description: Chest measurement; required to size a jacket

height.description: Height; passed to the fit engine and used when a chart lists Short, Regular or Long lengths

hips.description: Hips measurement; passed to the fit engine and checked when the official chart includes a hips column

inseam.description: Inseam measurement; accepted, but for pants the response notes that inseam isn't checked yet and to check the product's short/regular/long options

thigh.description: Thigh measurement; passed to the fit engine and checked when the official chart includes a thigh column

waist.description: Waist measurement; required to size pants

weight.description: Weight is accepted in the schema but is not used for sizing

product_name.description: Exact model, e.g. Klim Krios Pro or Bell MX-9 Adventure (needed for per-model helmet charts)

product_type.description: Item to size: jacket, pants, boots, helmet, or gloves

units.description: Units for all measurements (default: guessed from values)

name: size_recommendation
title: Motorcycle gear size recommendation
